sourceAuthor.name: LvlUrArti
sourceAuthor.relationship: Author of the ShiyuStats repository and the ShiyuDataProcessed aggregate dataset used by this artifact.

displayingPublisher.name: Prydwen
displayingPublisher.relationship: Displays and links the LvlUrArti ShiyuStats analytics; this artifact retains only the author's published aggregate composition observations.

scope.methodology: Publisher-described M0 / all-W-Engine aggregate fields. Per-team sample count and confidence interval are unavailable.
scope.targetUniverse: 97 adopted exact three-agent formations: the retained 44-target corpus plus 53 current default-unknown formations reviewed against the same six fixed aggregates; coverage is reported separately from rating.
scope.identityMapping: Stable IDs use existing explicit source-slug evidence; no stable-id-to-slug guessing is permitted.
scope.zeroObservationMeaning: A mapped exact formation with no matching row in the six fixed partitions is coverage-only zero observation, not a weakness, rating, or source invalidation.

fieldSemantics.characterSlugs: Original source slugs in the source row order; no identity or ordering inference is made here.
fieldSemantics.bangbooSlug: Original source Bangboo slug; observation only, not a default recommendation.
fieldSemantics.appRate: Raw source app_rate; popularity/coverage only and never a strength score.
fieldSemantics.avgRoundM0: Raw source avg_round M0 score points for the fixed 3.1.3 score-mode cycle; higher is better. A zero value is recorded as no M0 observation, never as a poor result.
fieldSemantics.avgRoundM1: Raw source avg_round_m1 score points for the fixed 3.1.3 score-mode cycle; higher is better. A zero value is recorded as no M1 observation.
fieldSemantics.observationCoverage: Each mapped target is classified by matching composition rows across the fixed six partitions; zero observation and identity-unmapped are distinct and neither determines a strength band.
fieldSemantics.metric: Each source declares kind=score, unit=points and direction=higher_is_better. Field names retain the upstream avg_round legacy naming and do not imply seconds.

boundary: Observed aggregate compositions report only fixed-revision exact-formation coverage and score points in named scenarios. They do not make app-rate, rank, score, percentile, or zero observation into a strength band; do not create or change a rating, default Bangboo, confidence interval, player-account result, Formal result, Import eligibility, or Blind label.

metricMethodEvidence.finding: Deadly Assault defaults to score mode. Shiyu Defense switches to score mode for cycles collected on or after 2025-12-30; the 3.1.3 cycle uses 5-1/5-2/5-3 and score ordering. Both modes therefore expose score points where higher is better.
